Why picking pairs works here

  • Each member weighs the same however many questions they answered, so nobody's enthusiasm counts twice.
  • The agreement score says whether the club wants the same kind of book or is split, and the best-to-worst column marks the divisive picks.
  • Swap in your own shortlist: titles, genres or themes all work.

What it doesn't do: It ranks what people would rather read, not what is available at the library or in paperback. Drop titles that are hard to get first.

Compared with what you'd use today

Polls in a group chat or a reading app's poll. A poll gives each person one vote and hides second choices; pairwise picks use everyone's whole order.

Under the hood: a Bradley-Terry model refit after every answer, an adaptive question picker, and a stop rule checked against simulated respondents, including ones whose picks are close calls. The method and its measurements.
